name: Benevolenz
description: Company visibly acts in the customer's interest, not only its own, through supportive and caring service.
detection_hint: Is there no proactive "we've got your back" moment anywhere in the flow (empathy, unsolicited help)?
example_fix: Add a proactive supportive touchpoint, e.g. "Need help deciding? Talk to us" before checkout.

name: Integritaet
description: Honest, transparent communication, including openly admitting limitations or mistakes.
detection_hint: Is there no acknowledgment anywhere of a limitation or trade-off?
example_fix: State one honest limitation or trade-off transparently rather than hiding it.

name: Interessen
description: The customer perceives that the company's and their own interests are genuinely aligned, not opposed.
detection_hint: Is copy framed only around company benefit ("boost our revenue" tone) rather than mutual gain?
example_fix: Reframe copy around mutual benefit ("this saves you money and helps us both grow").

name: Reziprozitaet
description: Trust is extended in both directions - the company shows it trusts the customer too.
detection_hint: Is there excessive verification or friction that implicitly signals distrust of the customer?
example_fix: Remove unnecessary verification steps that signal distrust of the customer.

name: Karma
description: The company's stated values match its actual behavior consistently over time.
detection_hint: Do marketing claims ("customer first") contradict actual policy details (harsh cancellation terms)?
example_fix: Align policy details concretely with the values stated in marketing.

name: Faehigkeit
description: The company demonstrably has the competence to deliver on its promise.
detection_hint: Are there no credentials, certifications, or proof of expertise shown near the offer?
example_fix: Add credentials, certifications, or proof of track record near the offer.

name: Kontinuitaet
description: The company reliably keeps its promises consistently across touchpoints and over time.
detection_hint: Is information or a promise inconsistent between the ad, landing page, and checkout?
example_fix: Audit and align promises across every touchpoint in the funnel.

name: Erfahrung
description: The customer has enough prior or repeated positive contact with the company to judge it fairly.
detection_hint: Is there no sequence of repeated touchpoints for first-time visitors before the ask?
example_fix: Build a short sequence of repeated positive touchpoints (email, retargeting) before the ask.

name: Reputation
description: Independent third parties vouch for the company's trustworthiness.
detection_hint: Are there no reviews, press mentions, or certifications displayed?
example_fix: Surface third-party reviews, press mentions, or certifications prominently.

name: Klarheit
description: The company reduces ambiguity by setting clear, unambiguous expectations.
detection_hint: Are terms, pricing, or next steps left vague or ambiguous anywhere in the flow?
example_fix: Replace vague language with explicit, concrete terms and next steps.
